verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "search across calls" alongside clips and playlists, and the product records transcripts and AI summaries for every meeting. Keyword alerts, topic monitoring and a conversational meeting assistant add ways to surface past content. Missing for 10: any documentation of what the search covers (transcripts vs. summaries vs. notes), any evidence of jumping to a timestamped moment in a recording, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
